content.title: Wave Life skyrockets on obesity drug trial, Strategy buys bitcoin
content.description:
Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma joins Market Domination host Josh Lipton to take a look at some of Monday's trending tickers and stories.

Carvana (CVNA) stock continues to gain on news that the company will be included in the S&P 500 (^GSPC).

Strategy (MSTR) stock is also moving higher after the company bought $962.7 million worth of bitcoin (BTC-USD).

Wave Life (WVE) stock is exploding after the company reported positive results from an early-stage obesity drug trial.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
